Elliot / Ben — forwarding my quick take after reviewing Aisha's checklist and your draft:

High-level guidance:
- 36-month amortization is acceptable for the HSM onboarding fee as a credit against committed ARR, but we should limit to customers who take a minimum committed spend (suggest $120k ARR). Credit schedule: monthly straight-line credit reducing by 1/36th of the onboarding fee. Include a clawback if they drop below commit during the term.
- Seat-based HSM is fine as an alternate for smaller pilots; price per seat should include 12 months of support/attestation. Recommend $18k/seat for US region (benchmarked).
- Audit log retention: provide four retention SKUs: 30d (base, included), 90d (+$0.008/GB/mo), 365d (+$0.02/GB/mo), 730d (+$0.035/GB/mo). Add an ingest discount band for >5TB/mo.
- KMS hotpath: we can offer a pilot blend (3 months) where managed KMS hotpath is included in token pricing, after which it reverts to the standard hotpath surcharge unless they commit to dedicated KMS capacity.

Operational asks for the quote: define commit threshold for amortization, the clawback language (simple %), and whether procurement needs an SOW addendum. I can draft the amortization line and the clause — want to keep it short and operational.

I'll attach a sample amortization clause and a one‑page credit schedule; please review and we'll finalize before sending to Horizon.

Marissa Cole
Finance — Commercial Programs
Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha — looping Marissa into the thread with our recommended structure.

Summary of the proposed lanes (attached one-pager):
1) Upfront — HSM onboarding fee: $216,000 one-time + KMS managed hotpath surcharge: $0.03/token-equivalent for pilot; Audit log tiers as listed.
2) 36-month amortization — onboarding fee credited against commit: $216,000 amortized straight-line over 36 months if customer meets $120k ARR commit; monthly credit shows as a deduction on invoices. Clawback if commit not maintained (pro-rata).
3) Seat alt — $18,000/seat (includes first-year attestation & support). Good for pilots sub-6 months.

Action items for Horizon: confirm whether procurement prefers the amortization lane (we'll draft the short addendum) or the seat route. If amortization, confirm desired commit threshold — our standard ask is $120k ARR but open to discuss.

Attachments: Horizon_AuditRequirements.pdf (from you), Redwood one‑pager (amortization + seat alt).
